privacyText: Iki gikoresho gikoresha ibikorwa vy'ubuhinga bwa none kugira ngo gikoreshe ibibazo vy'abakoresha. Ibiyago birakurwaho iyo uvuye kuri iyi paji. Turagusavye ntushiremwo amakuru y’agaciro canke yerekana umuntu.
aboutDescription: Iki gikoresho cakozwe na Yahya Qanie, gifashijwe na Lena Slachmuijlder na Saji Prelis ya Search for Common Ground, kandi n’iterambere ry’ubuhinga ryayobowe na Murtaza Qanie. Yaremewe kugira ngo amakuru yerekeye umurongo w’ibikorwa vy’Urubyiruko, Amahoro n’Umutekano — ashingiye ku ngingo 2250 y’Inama y’Umutekano y’Ishirahamwe mpuzamakungu ONU — ashobore gushikirwa no gukomeza umuhari wa YPS mu mashirahamwe, mu banyeshure, no mu bashinga amategeko.
aboutSourcesDescription: Iki gikoresho gishingiye ku bumenyi bucungiwe burimwo ingingo n’imirongo ngenderwako y’ishirahamwe mpuzamakungu ONU biboneka ku mugaragaro, ibitabu vy’ishirahamwe mpuzamakungu ONU, inyandiko z’imiryango y’akarere, imigambi y’ibikorwa n’ingene igihugu gikora, ubushakashatsi bw’inyigisho, n’ibitabu vya sosiyete sivile n’imiryango itegamiye kuri Leta.
emptySubtitle: Hitamwo umugwi w'inkomoko maze utangure ikiyago.
starter1: Guca mu ncamake umurongo w'ibikorwa vy'urubyiruko, amahoro n'umutekano
starter2: Ni ubuhe buryo bwiza bwo gushiramwo urubyiruko mu gufata ingingo?
starter3: Tanga ivyiyumviro vy’imigambi yo kwubaka amahoro mu micungararo yo muri Aziya yo Hagati.
starter4: Ni intambwe izihe zo gutegura Gahunda y’Igihugu y’Ibikorwa?
